awarding_body.detail: The site newhorizonsforwomen.org.nz is the awarding body's own domain: the Education Awards page, FAQs and awards register are published by the New Horizons for Women Trust: Hine Kahukura itself, not an aggregator, news article or blog.
awarding_body.quote: Have not previously received a New Horizons for Women Trust: Hine Kahukura award at the level of study being applied for

deadline.detail: The record's deadline is exactly right but past: the 2026 Education Awards round (for study in 2027) closed at 11.59 pm on Tuesday 25 August 2026, as the FAQ page states, and the Education Awards page now reads 'Applications are CLOSED'. The awards overview states 'All General award applications are closed until 2027'. As of 12 October 2026 there is no currently-open Education Awards cycle, so the record cannot be verified as open.
deadline.quote: Applications close at 11.59 pm on Tuesday, 25 August 2026.

eligibility.detail: Every distinct claim in the record is confirmed on the Education Awards page: women only; enrolled in an NZQA or Universities NZ approved tertiary qualification for study in 2027, all fields; New Zealand citizen or ordinarily resident with at least three years on a resident-class visa, or a refugee/protected person of New Zealand; and no previous Trust award at the level applied for. The page adds one criterion the record omits (not enrolled in secondary school unless as an adult student), and the FAQ adds two exclusions: no postgraduate study, and study must be at NZQA-approved institutions in New Zealand. These are additions, not contradictions.
eligibility.quote: Are enrolled in an NZQA or Universities NZ approved tertiary qualification for study in 2027 (all fields of study are welcome). | Are a New Zealand citizen or are ordinarily resident in New Zealand and either have lived here on a resident-class visa for at least three years or are a refugee or protected person of New Zealand. | Are studying at Certificate level (NZQCF level 3-4) or Diploma level (NZQCF level 5-6) or Degree level (NZQCF level 7). | Have not previously received a New Horizons for Women Trust: Hine Kahukura award at the level of study being applied for

funding.detail: The awards are one-off grants of fixed value determined by NZQA level - $1,000 at Levels 3-4, $1,500 at Levels 5-6 and $3,000 at Level 7 - to help cover the costs of education. This is partial support, not tuition coverage, so the record's 'Partially Funded' classification is accurate.
funding.quote: The value of awards is determined by the NZQA level the applicant is studying at, and may differ from year to year depending on the funds available: | Levels 3-4 $1000 | Levels 5-6 $1500 | Level 7 $3000

degree_levels.detail: The page offers Certificate (NZQCF levels 3-4), Diploma (NZQCF levels 5-6) and Degree (NZQCF level 7, i.e. Bachelor's), matching the record's 'Certificate, Diploma, Bachelor's'. The FAQ confirms postgraduate study is excluded from Education Awards.
degree_levels.quote: Are studying at Certificate level (NZQCF level 3-4) or Diploma level (NZQCF level 5-6) or Degree level (NZQCF level 7).

recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Official site live and accurate on 12 Oct 2026. The 2026 round closed 25 Aug 2026 and the next general round reopens in 2027 (deadlines historically late August), so re-check around May-July 2027 for the next cycle. The Education Awards page itself shows no deadline date; the exact closing time (11.59 pm, Tuesday 25 August 2026) is stated only on /faqs.html. The FAQ page's HTML title tag oddly reads 'Research Awards' though the content is correct. Award values ($1,000/$1,500/$3,000 by NZQA level) may change year to year per the page.

notes_for_reviewer: All substantive claims in the record (awarding body, deadline date and time, eligibility, partial funding, degree levels) match the awarding body's own pages exactly, so there is nothing to correct - but the only cycle ever published for this programme closed at 11.59 pm on 25 August 2026 and the awards overview states all general applications are closed until 2027. Because there is no currently-open cycle on 12 October 2026, the record cannot be marked active under the campaign rules; needs_review is kept until the next round opens in 2027. A human may also want to add the two eligibility criteria found on the official pages but missing from the record: applicants must not be enrolled in secondary school (unless as an adult student), and postgraduate study is excluded. Note the only New Horizons award currently open is the different Sonja Davies Peace Award (closes 30 October 2026), which must not be conflated with these Education Awards.
